stages.block_reason: Step5d is defined as the complete paper-faithful strict TASE RNN reproduction route. It is not runnable until paper-truth extraction is closed, strict RNN equations are implemented without DLS/IK fallback, calibrated Pinocchio FK/Jacobian is integrated, qdot register path and numeric sanity pass, a new non-quarantine package is generated, controller read-back is verified, and a separate live plan is accepted.
rnn_completion_gates: config/step5c_tase_paper_truth.json has no pending_pdf_verify fields and strict_rnn_enabled=true
tools/step5c_strict_rnn.py implements finite-time TASE RNN equations without NotImplementedError
strict solver has no DLS fallback and no IK fallback
strict solver uses Eq.(23a) projection_input = J.T @ lambda_state and never theta_dot_state - J.T @ lambda_state
strict solver exposes state, lambda, projection/saturation, sigr exponent, gain matrix, force-motion task, and orientation compliance diagnostics
tools/step5d_paper_outer_loop.py implements paper-form xdot_c from Eq.(7)/(8)/(13)/(14)/(16)/(17) without the old cross-product orientation shortcut
solver uses calibrated Pinocchio FK/J(q), not experiments/.../ur10e_nominal.xml
offline qdot register path proof passes for registers 37..47
tools/step5d_full_chain_sanity.py structural offline chain passes with explicit no-contact assumptions
fresh Step5d numeric sanity artifact passes for the exact route
new non-quarantine Step5d TP package validates locally and contains speedj executor only after the above gates
controller upload and read-back SHA/cachedContents verification pass
separate Step5d live dry-run plan is explicitly accepted before bridge or TP Play

filter_policy.compatibility_gate: Decide from PDF truth whether filtered-live normal is allowed; do not inherit v31 filtering silently.

stages.success_condition: Complete Step5d only when the strict TASE RNN paper equations drive calibrated UR10e qdot commands through registers 37..42, force-motion and orientation-compliance diagnostics match the paper-defined task contract, controller package read-back is verified, and a separately accepted live dry-run/contact evidence artifact passes. Do not mark complete from DLS, IK, calibrated-only, or register-path-only evidence.
